You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From b01f15a7571b7aa222458bc9bf26ab59bd84e384 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Benjamin Poirier <bpoirier@nvidia.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2024 19:12:32 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] selftests: bonding: Increase timeout to 1200s

When tests are run by runner.sh, bond_options.sh gets killed before
it can complete:

make -C tools/testing/selftests run_tests TARGETS="drivers/net/bonding"
	[...]
	# timeout set to 120
	# selftests: drivers/net/bonding: bond_options.sh
	# TEST: prio (active-backup miimon primary_reselect 0)                [ OK ]
	# TEST: prio (active-backup miimon primary_reselect 1)                [ OK ]
	# TEST: prio (active-backup miimon primary_reselect 2)                [ OK ]
	# TEST: prio (active-backup arp_ip_target primary_reselect 0)         [ OK ]
	# TEST: prio (active-backup arp_ip_target primary_reselect 1)         [ OK ]
	# TEST: prio (active-backup arp_ip_target primary_reselect 2)         [ OK ]
	#
	not ok 7 selftests: drivers/net/bonding: bond_options.sh # TIMEOUT 120 seconds

This test includes many sleep statements, at least some of which are
related to timers in the operation of the bonding driver itself. Increase
the test timeout to allow the test to complete.

I ran the test in slightly different VMs (including one without HW
virtualization support) and got runtimes of 13m39.760s, 13m31.238s, and
13m2.956s. Use a ~1.5x "safety factor" and set the timeout to 1200s.

Fixes: 42a8d4aaea84 ("selftests: bonding: add bonding prio option test")
Reported-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/netdev/20240116104402.1203850a@kernel.org/#t
Suggested-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Benjamin Poirier <bpoirier@nvidia.com>
Reviewed-by: Hangbin Liu <liuhangbin@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240118001233.304759-1-bpoirier@nvidia.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/drivers/net/bonding/settings b/tools/testing/selftests/drivers/net/bonding/settings
index 6091b45d226b..79b65bdf05db 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/drivers/net/bonding/settings
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/drivers/net/bonding/settings
@@ -1 +1 @@
-timeout=120
+timeout=1200
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/testing/selftests/drivers/net/bonding/settings`**
   - The timeout value was changed from `120` seconds to `1200` seconds.

### Relationships

The modification in the `settings` file increases the timeout for the bonding self-tests from 2 minutes to 20 minutes. This change addresses the issue where the test script `bond_options.sh` was being killed due to exceeding the previous timeout limit. The increase is based on observed test runtimes in various environments, ensuring that the tests can complete successfully without being prematurely terminated. This patch is a direct response to a reported timeout issue and aims to enhance the reliability of the self-tests for the bonding driver.

Fixes: 42a8d4aaea84 ("selftests: bonding: add bonding prio option test")
Reported-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/netdev/20240116104402.1203850a@kernel.org/#t

Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the `bond_options.sh` test script exceeding the previously set timeout of 120 seconds, which was insufficient for the test to complete due to the presence of multiple sleep statements and the inherent timing behavior of the bonding driver. This led to the script being killed before it could finish executing.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```bash

# timeout set to 120
```
Reason:
The `timeout` variable was set to 120 seconds, which was insufficient for the `bond_options.sh` test script to complete due to the presence of multiple sleep statements and the timing behavior of the bonding driver. This caused the script to be killed before it could finish executing.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```bash
timeout=1200
```
Reason:
The `timeout` variable was increased to 1200 seconds, allowing sufficient time for the `bond_options.sh` test script to complete its execution, thus preventing it from being killed prematurely.
